1.e4 e5 2.Nf3 Nc6 3.Nc3 Nf6 4.d4 exd4 5..strategy: Pins the e4 knight to the king and attacks it, with nothing yet defending it, while the d5 knight adds pressure around c7. Black has to defend at once and accurately; the move is the sharpest test of the pawn grab.

Defends the pinned knight with a pawn and so keeps the extra pawn. The price is a weakened kingside and an open diagonal from the king, and the pin is still there, so Black has to meet White's piece play with care.
